name: Leo Ho

intro.headline: From complex problems to working software.
intro.description: Software developer who builds for fun, to learn new tech, and to make my own development work more convenient, mostly with small tools and plugins. A gamer at heart, from board and card games to video games, which is why I’m building one: DFA, a side-view action game in Godot.

about.lead: Curious about new tech, impatient with repetitive work.
paragraphs: Since 2022, I’ve worked on clinic-management software used by more than 600 clinics and 2,000 doctors. I take features end to end, from the first requirement to production.

Outside work, I ship the things I want to use: developer tools that anyone can install from my own plugin marketplace, and an action game I’m building, because I love games. Each project is an excuse to learn something new.
about.heading: Side quests welcome.

experience.description: Building features in Angular, from day-to-day clinical workflows to the patient form used by many of our clients.
Worked across mobile and web: an internal mobile prototype in Flutter and a back-office system in Angular.

contact.label: Keep in touch
contact.heading: Good things start with a conversation.

footer: Made with curiosity. Built to keep growing.
